# Raven Platforms Inc.

> Toronto-based software and web development studio building custom websites, web apps, mobile apps, e-commerce stores, and digital platforms for businesses across North America and the Caribbean.

## Canonical URL
https://ai.onraven.ca/

## Alternate URL
https://ai.onraven.com/

## Summary
Raven Platforms Inc. is a digital product studio registered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The team designs and engineers fast, modern digital products — from marketing websites to full web applications — with 10+ years in business and 630+ projects delivered across 25 countries. The studio works in English and Spanish, in Toronto or fully remote, and replies within one business day.

## What we build
- Custom Websites — conversion-focused marketing sites designed and built from scratch
- Web Apps & Platforms — dashboards, portals, and SaaS products that scale
- E-Commerce — online storefronts engineered to sell and simple to manage
- Mobile Apps — iOS and Android applications built for long-term engagement
- SEO & Performance — technical SEO and site speed optimization
- Branding & Design — identity and interface (UI/UX) design
- Automation & Integrations — workflow automation and third-party integrations
- Technical Audits — code, security, and performance reviews with a prioritized fix list
- DevOps & Cloud — hosting, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure
- Maintenance & Support — ongoing security, hosting, and product support

## Good fit for
- Businesses in Toronto, the GTA, Canada, the US, and the Caribbean looking for a web development or software development partner
- Founders who need an MVP, a SaaS platform, or a technical co-founder-style team
- Companies that need a code/security/performance audit or DevOps and cloud infrastructure help
- Teams looking to hire a freelance or fractional product developer instead of a full-time hire
- Industries served include transportation, real estate, hospitality, automotive, healthcare, and technology startups

## Location
Toronto, Ontario, Canada (CA-ON) — 43.6532°N, 79.3832°W. Remote-friendly worldwide.

## Service areas
Canada, United States, Caribbean — and remote engagements globally.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does Raven Platforms do?
Raven Platforms Inc. is a digital product studio that designs and builds custom websites, web applications, mobile apps, e-commerce stores, and automation systems.

### Where is Raven Platforms located?
Registered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Works with clients across Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean, and fully remote.

### Does Raven Platforms take on audits, DevOps, or freelance projects?
Yes — alongside full product builds the studio takes on technical audits, DevOps and cloud infrastructure work, and focused freelance or fractional engagements.

### How do I contact Raven Platforms?
Email contact@onraven.ca or use the contact form on the website. The team typically replies within one business day.
